 Anuraag Chatterjee Wed, November 18, 2026 at 10:21 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Miramax Films Peter Chelsom's 2001 romantic comedy Serendipity is getting a remake from Miramax and Amazon MGM Studios. The new movie cast includes The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping alum Whitney Peak , alongside Off Campus breakout star Stephen Kalyn .
 Deadline reported that the duo has joined the cast, which also includes Milo Manheim. It hasn't been disclosed which characters the actors will play. The original film featured John Cusack and Kate Beckinsale as its leads.
 Michael Showalter will direct the project. The remake will be written by Marc Klein, who also penned the original feature. While the movie received mixed reviews from critics, it earned a warmer reception from audiences, as reflected in its Rotten Tomatoes ratings. The critical consensus called it "light and charming," giving it a 57% Tomatometer rating, while audiences awarded it a 79% Popcornmeter rating. It grossed $77.5 million against a $28 million budget.
 What was the original Serendipity movie with John Cusack about?
 The 2001 film Serendipity follows John Cusack's Jonathan Trager and Kate Beckinsale's Sara Thomas, two strangers who fall in love on Christmas Eve. The catch was that both are engaged to other people. They part ways and continue with their lives, but seven years after that fateful night, they begin searching for each other.
 Beyond Beckinsale and Cusack, the original movie's cast included Molly Shannon, Jeremy Piven, John Corbett, Bridget Moynahan, Eugene Levy, Lucy Gordon, Leo Fitzpatrick, Buck Henry, Kevin Rice, Eve Crawford, and Marcia Bennett.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Executive producers on the remake include Jonathan Glickman, Alexandra Loewy, and Thom Zadra, along with scribe Klein. Production companies include Semi-Formal Productions and Miramax. No additional cast has been revealed. Plot details also remain under wraps. No release date has been set for the movie either.
